q: 1. The chart which gives an estimate about the amount of materials handling between various workstation is known as
explain: A travel chart tabulates the quantity of material moved between workstations, so it is used to analyse material handling.

q: 2. Slack time in PERT analysis
options: can never be greater than zero
is always zero for critical activities
can never be less than zero
explain: Critical events have the minimum slack (zero or negative). Per the answer key, d is correct.

q: 3. If the completion time for a particular project is 20 weeks and its earliest expected time is 22 weeks, then the slack time for the project is
explain: Slack = latest allowable time – earliest expected time = 20 – 22 = –2 weeks.

q: 4. Interfering float is the difference between
explain: Interfering float = total float – free float.

q: 5. Which of the following is not an excavating equipment?
explain: Per the answer key, scraper is the odd one out (it is mainly a hauling/spreading machine); shovel, dragline and hoe are excavators.

q: 6. For excavating solid rocks, the most suitable equipment is
explain: The answer key gives hoe (d). Note: many textbooks name the power shovel for blasted rock.

q: 7. The size of a power shovel is indicated by the size of
explain: A power shovel is rated by its dipper (bucket) capacity in cubic metres or cubic yards.

q: 8. Which one of the following does not form a part of Derrick crane?
explain: A derrick crane consists of a mast, boom and guy ropes; a jack is not part of it.

q: 9. Which one of the following does not fall under the category hoisting equipment?
explain: A dragline is an excavator, not hoisting equipment. Per the key, d is correct.

q: 10. Tractive coefficient of a Crawler truck in loose soil is
options: less than that of rubber tyre tractors
more than it at of rubber tyre tractors
same as that of rubber tyre tractors
explain: Tracks grip loose soil better than rubber tyres, so the tractive coefficient is higher.

q: 11. The handling of materials in the construction of a multistoreyed building will require for lifting
explain: Vertical lifting of materials in multistoreyed buildings is done by hoists.

q: 12. The construction equipment suitable for lifting and transportation is
explain: Per the answer key, lift truck and spiral chute (a and c) are suitable.

q: 13. The maximum amount of advance payment (mobilization fund) permitted is ……… of contract amount.
explain: Per the answer key, the maximum is 20% of the contract amount.

q: 14. Which part of contract documents describes the process of performing any item's of requirements?
explain: Specifications describe the materials, quality and method of performing each item of work.

q: 15. The first stage of construction is
explain: A construction project begins with the initiation of the proposal (conception).

q: 16. Vibratory rollers are more useful for compacting which of the following
explain: Vibration rearranges granular particles into a dense state, so it suits sandy (cohesionless) soils best.

q: 17. Bottom-dump wagons are suitable for handling which of the following
explain: Free-flowing materials such as sand and gravel discharge easily from bottom-dump wagons. Sticky clay and large rocks do not.

q: 18. Which one of the following rollers is suitable for soil cement stabilized road construction?
explain: Per the answer key, vibratory roller (a) is correct.

q: 19. The most suitable type of equipment for compaction of cohesive soils is
explain: Sheep foot rollers knead and compact clayey (cohesive) soils.

q: 20. A crusher which can be used as either primary or secondary crusher is
explain: Per the answer key, hammer mill (a). Note: some books give jaw crusher.

q: 21. Price adjustment in any contract will be done if price change exceeds by
explain: Per the answer key, adjustment applies when the price change exceeds 10%.

q: 22. The best method of procurement for complex and work of specific nature is
explain: Complex, specialised works need wide competition and expertise, so International Competitive Bidding (ICB) is used.

q: 23. A concrete mixer is specified by
options: the volume of the mixing drum
volume of mixed concrete discharges after mixing of each batch
explain: Mixers are rated by their output, the volume of mixed concrete discharged per batch.

q: 24. The horse power of driving motor of a 5 cubic metre concrete mixer would be about
explain: Per the answer key, about 5 HP.

q: 25. Material used for the construction of load bearing piles is
explain: Load-bearing piles can be made of timber, concrete or steel.

q: 26. Which of the following equipments is not used for hauling
explain: Per the answer key, d (scrapers). Note: a dragline is an excavator, so many books give c.

q: 27. During the construction period, price variation clause in contracts caters to
options: increase in rates of only important materials
variation in cost in materials element, labour element and petrol-oil-lubricant element
variation in total cost of the project on an ad hoc basis
explain: The price variation clause adjusts for changes in the material, labour and POL cost components.

q: 28. At a work site, statistical quality control of concrete means
options: measurement of risks to eliminate failures
applying the theory of probability to sample testing or inspection
reduction in wastage of inspection costs
reduction in costs for the removal of defects
explain: SQC applies probability theory to sample testing or inspection.

q: 29. Mobilization advance up to 10% of the cost of work is given to a contractor
options: on commencement of work at site for payment of loan taken by him
for the purchase of construction materials
for the payment of advances to labour and other staff
for all activities required to start the work at site on finalization of the contract document
explain: Mobilization advance covers all start-up activities needed to begin work after the contract is finalised.

q: 30. Security deposit deducted at 5% from contractor's bills is
options: refunded when the contractor has completed the work
refunded even before the completion of the work provided good progress has been established
retained till the expected life of the structure of say 100 years and spent for maintenance
refunded when the defect liability period of six months or one monsoon whichever is later is over
explain: The deposit is released only after the defect liability period ends.

q: 31. Sinking fund is
options: the fund for rebuilding a structure when its economic life is over
the total sum to be paid to the municipal authorities by the tenants
a part of the money kept in reserve for providing additional structure and structural modifications
explain: A sinking fund is set aside periodically to rebuild or replace a structure at the end of its economic life.

q: 32. Which of the following conveyor is never used?
explain: All three types are used in practice, so none is 'never used'.

q: 33. A canal is trimmed on its side and bottom by
explain: A trimmer is the machine used to trim canal sides and bottom to the final shape.

q: 34. The amount saved as depreciation reserve fund will be termed as
explain: It is a reserve set aside for replacement, so it is none of operating cost, profit or loss.

q: 35. The direct cost of a project with respect normal time is
explain: Direct cost is lowest at the normal duration and rises as the project is crashed.

q: 36. The reduction in project time normally results in
options: decreasing the direct cost and increasing indirect cost
increasing the direct cost and decreasing the indirect cost
increasing the direct cost and indirect cost both
decreasing the direct cost and indirect cost both
explain: Crashing raises direct cost, while a shorter duration lowers indirect cost (overheads).

q: 37. Economic saving of time result by crashing
explain: Only critical activities shorten the project, and the cheapest one adds the least cost.

q: 38. The process of incorporating changes and rescheduling or preplanning is called
explain: Updating revises the network for actual progress and changes, then reschedules.

q: 39. Slack time refers to
explain: Per the answer key, slack applies to both events and activities (event slack and activity float).

q: 40. Which of the following is the correct from of representation of an event?
explain: In network diagrams an event (node) is drawn as a circle; activities are arrows.

q: 41. Which of the following is not related to cost slope?
explain: Cost slope = (crash cost – normal cost)/(normal time – crash time). Slack is not part of it.

q: 42. Use of dummies is required for
explain: Dummies give unique event numbering (the 'grammatical' purpose) and show correct dependencies (the 'logical' purpose).

q: 43. In a line organization
options: responsibility of each individual is fixed
explain: Line organization has strong discipline, quick decisions and fixed responsibility.

q: 44. In a functional organization
options: specialised knowledge and guidance to individual worker is provided
explain: Specialisation gives better quality, less wastage and expert guidance.

q: 45. The salient feature of the organization evolved by F.W. Taylor is
options: separation of planning and design part for field work
explain: Taylor's functional organization separates planning from execution and relies on functional efficiency and strict specifications.

q: 46. The major principle of an organization is
explain: Span of management, unity of command and delegation of authority are all basic principles.

q: 47. Time and progress chart are also known as
explain: Per the answer key, d.

q: 48. The process of calculating the resources requirement of a project is known as
explain: Resource aggregation sums the resource requirement of all activities over time.

q: 49. The use of bar chart is very popular in construction department because
options: it is very simple to prepare and interpret
each item of work or activity is shown separately
modification to the chart, if required, can be carried out easily
explain: Bar charts are simple, show each activity separately and are easy to modify.

q: 50. The constraints in case of resource smoothening operation would be
options: both resources and project duration time
explain: In smoothening the project duration is fixed, and resources are adjusted within it. Per the key, b.

q: 51. Updating may result in
explain: Updating can change the critical path and either shorten or lengthen the completion time.

q: 52. Crash project duration is obtained by summing the
options: normal durations for all the activities
crash durations for all the activities along the critical path obtained by taking into account the normal duration for the activities
crash durations for all the activities along the critical path obtained by taking into account the crash duration for all the activities
explain: Crash duration is the sum of crash durations along the critical path, found after all activities are crashed.

q: 53. In CPM
options: time optimisation is given prime importance
cost optimisation is given prime importance
cost is directly proportional to time
explain: CPM stresses time-cost trade-off, so cost optimisation is the prime concern.

q: 54. Indirect cost of the project
options: decrease up to optimum duration and then increase with duration
explain: Indirect cost (overheads) rises with project duration.

q: 55. If a contractor is found corrupt for tender work, then what should be done by concerned office?
explain: Per the answer key, his tender is cancelled.

q: 56. The process of removal and loading of broken rock pieces from a tunnel is known as
explain: Mucking is the removal and loading of blasted rock (muck) in tunnelling.

q: 57. The effectiveness of explosion during increases by the process of
explain: Stemming (packing the hole above the charge) confines the blast and raises its effectiveness.

q: 58. Work study comprises
explain: Work study = method study + work measurement.

q: 59. Gnatt chart indicates
options: balance of work to be done
comparison of actual progress with the scheduled progress
explain: A Gantt chart compares actual progress against the schedule.

q: 60. On a bar chart the various activities of a project are shown by
explain: Each activity is a horizontal bar drawn against the time scale.

q: 61. Jobs going ahead of schedule are conveniently shown in
explain: Per the answer key, Gantt chart.

q: 62. The weakness in bar chart is
options: uncertainty in duration for various activities
the sequence of activities is not very clear
explain: Bar charts do not show interdependencies, uncertainty or clear sequence.

q: 63. A milestone chart
options: shows the interdependence of various jobs
shows the events in chronological, but not in a logical sequence
explain: Milestone charts list events in time order without showing logical links.

q: 64. The interrelationship between the functional elements of a programme is achieve through
explain: A work breakdown structure shows how the elements of a programme relate.

q: 65. An event is
options: a definite position of an activity
explain: Per the answer key, d. An event is an instant at which activities start or finish.

q: 66. The scheduled completion time of an operation in CPM chart is mentioned on
options: left top corner outside the circle
left top corner inside the circle
explain: Per the answer key, it is shown at the top left, outside the circle.

q: 67. The probability factor Z in PERT is given by
options: (scheduled time – earliest expected time) / standard deviation
(latest allowable time – scheduled time) / standard deviation
explain: Z = (TS – TE)/σ, where TS is the scheduled time and TE the earliest expected time.

q: 68. If the probability factor is zero, the chances of completing the project in scheduled time are
explain: Z = 0 corresponds to the mean of the normal curve, so the probability is 50%.

q: 69. Float may be defined as the difference between
options: latest start time and the earliest start time
latest finish time and the earliest finish time
time available and the time required to complete the activity
explain: All three expressions give the float.

q: 70. Which of the following is a PERT event?
explain: An event is a milestone (a completion). The other options are ongoing activities.
